rows.text: For the last four days water to our building (Sai Krupa Apartments, 3rd Cross, Vidyaranyapura) comes only about ten minutes in the morning and pressure is so low it never reaches the overhead tank, the buildings on either side are getting normal supply so something is wrong with our valve
rows.summary: Only ten minutes of low‑pressure water each morning at Sai Krupa Apartments, buildings beside receive normal supply.
rows.note: PAIR 1A - piped drinking water pressure, one building, alternate arrangement still possible, so medium.

rows.text: No water at all in our whole street for 6 days now, 2nd Cross Vidyaranyapura, roughly 40 houses. We are buying tanker water at Rs 1200 a trip and half the families here cannot afford that. Nobody at the sub division office picks up the phone.
rows.summary: No water for six days on a street of ~40 houses, residents buying expensive tanker water.
rows.note: PAIR 1B - same service, but total outage across ~40 households for six days, so high.

rows.text: bhai ye manhole ka dhakkan pichle 2 din se gayab hai, MG road ke peeche wali gali me, raat ko bilkul dikhta nahi aur bacche wahi cricket khelte hai, koi andar gir gaya to jaan chali jayegi, please aaj hi cover lagwao
rows.summary: Manhole cover missing for two days; children play nearby, risk of falling in.
rows.note: PAIR 2A - open manhole, cover absent, children playing over it: fall into a sewer chamber kills, so critical.

rows.text: usi gali me ek aur manhole hai jiska dhakkan laga hua hai lekin crack hai, gaadi upar se jaati hai to khadakta hai aur awaaz aati hai, abhi koi girne wala khatra nahi hai but replace kar dijiye warna baad me tut jayega
rows.summary: Manhole cover cracked, makes noise when vehicles pass; no current fall risk but could break later.
rows.location_text: adjacent manhole in the same lane
rows.note: PAIR 2B - same chamber type, cover present though cracked, nobody exposed, so a scheduled replacement at medium.

rows.text: सड़क पर पिछले तीन दिन से पीने के पानी की पाइपलाइन फूटी पड़ी है, साफ पानी लगातार बहकर बर्बाद हो रहा है और उसी वजह से पूरी कॉलोनी में प्रेशर आधा हो गया है, कृपया जल्दी ठीक करवाइए
rows.summary: Water pipe burst on road for three days, causing continuous waste and reducing colony water pressure by half.
rows.note: PAIR 3A - the water on the road is treated drinking water from a main, so water supply owns the repair; colony wide loss makes it high.

rows.text: उसी जगह पर अब गंदा नाली का पानी सड़क पर बह रहा है, बदबू के मारे वहाँ खड़ा नहीं हुआ जाता, बच्चे स्कूल जाते समय उसी पानी में से निकलते हैं, कृपया चैंबर साफ करवाइए
rows.summary: Dirty drain water spilling onto street, causing foul smell and exposing schoolchildren.
rows.note: PAIR 3B - identical picture of water across the road, but it is sewage, so drainage does the repair; urgency held at high.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಬಡಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಇಡೀ ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಫ್ಯಾನ್ ಲೈಟ್ ಏನೂ ಬರುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಬೀದಿ ದೀಪಗಳೂ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮರ್ ಹಾಳಾಗಿದೆ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ
rows.summary: Transformer failure leaves entire neighbourhood without electricity for three days.
rows.note: PAIR 4A - houses are dark too, so the fault is upstream supply, not the lighting circuit; whole layout for 3 nights is high.

rows.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಬೀದಿಯ ಮನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ರಸ್ತೆ ದೀಪಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಹತ್ತು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಇಡೀ ರಸ್ತೆ ಕತ್ತಲು, ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಬರೋಕೆ ಭಯ ಪಡ್ತಾರೆ
rows.summary: All streetlights on the road dark for ten days, making residents feel unsafe.
rows.note: PAIR 4B - domestic power is fine, so only the street lighting circuit has failed; a fully dark street for ten days is high.

rows.text: எங்க தெருவுல ரெண்டு நாளா குப்பை வண்டி வரலை, வீட்டு முன்னாடி கவர்ல கட்டி வெச்சிருக்கோம், கொஞ்சம் நாத்தம் அடிக்குது, தயவுசெஞ்சு வண்டிய அனுப்புங்க
rows.summary: Garbage collection missed for two days, causing the local bin to overflow.
rows.note: PAIR 5A - two missed collection days on one street, bagged waste, contained nuisance, so medium.

rows.text: எங்க தெருவுல மூணு வாரமா குப்பை வண்டியே வரவே இல்ல, மூலையில குப்பை மலை மாதிரி சேர்ந்து சாலையில பாதி அடைச்சிடுச்சு, நாய் எலி புழு எல்லாம் இருக்கு, தெருவுல நாலஞ்சு குழந்தைகளுக்கு வாந்தி பேதி வந்திருக்கு
rows.summary: Three weeks without garbage pickup led to a massive waste pile blocking the road and making children ill.
rows.note: PAIR 5B - same missed collection but three weeks, blocking the carriageway with illness already appearing, so high.
